name: Fruity
description: Bright, often fruit-forward notes — common in washed, high-grown coffees and lighter roasts.

name: Floral
description: Delicate aromatic notes reminiscent of flowers, most noticeable while the coffee is still hot and by smell.

name: Sweet
description: Notes that read as sugary rather than fruity, usually the first thing you notice on the front of the tongue.

name: Nutty & Cocoa
description: Warm, rounded notes common in medium roasts and many Central and South American coffees.

name: Spice
description: Warm background notes that show up more as a coffee cools, often paired with fuller-bodied or darker-roasted coffees.

name: Earthy & Roasted
description: Deeper, heavier notes that become more prominent the darker a coffee is roasted.
